text:
Silver Price in 2000
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2000, the LBMA silver price fell 13.0% between 2000-01-31 ($5.26) and 2000-12-29 ($4.58). The highest sampled price was $5.26 in January and the lowest was $4.58 in December. The mean of these observations was $4.90. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
